gold_tool: gopls v0.23.0 rename -w binding.Binding.Name (default build) plus a second gopls pass with -tags=nomsgpack for binding/binding_nomsgpack.go (go1.26.3, GOTOOLCHAIN=local); gofmt on changed files
instruction: The method `Name()` on the `binding.Binding` interface (binding/binding.go) is too generic and easy to confuse with the many other `Name` methods and fields in gin. Rename `Binding.Name` to `BindingName`. The rename must cover the interface declaration (in every build variant of the package), every binding type that implements it, and every call site, including tests. `BindingUri` declares its own separate `Name()` method; it and the `Name` method of the type that implements only `BindingUri` are not part of this change and must keep their names, as must every other unrelated `Name` method, field or variable. Behavior must not change: the project must still build and its tests must pass.
notes: binding/binding_nomsgpack.go (build tag nomsgpack) redeclares Binding; the default-tag gopls pass does not see it, so a second tagged pass renamed it. Default-tag tests never compile that file, so missing it is a silent miss. BindingUri.Name / uriBinding.Name are not coupled to Binding.Name by the type system (uriBinding has no Bind method) and gopls leaves them.
